blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
London runs on public transport. There is the Tube, the bus, the train, and the black cab. Each one has its own rules and its own rhythm.

Today you learn a small structure: by + transport. It is the shortest way in English to say how you get anywhere. You say "by Tube", "by bus", "by train". You do not use "the" here.

There is one exception. You do not say "by foot". You say "on foot". A cab is fast, but it is expensive. Walking is often the quickest option in central London.

items.q: What is the text mainly about?
options: How to get around in London
The price of a black cab
How to buy a ticket online
items.why: O texto fala de como se locomover em Londres com "by + transport".

items.q: How do you say the way you travel in English?
items.why: "You do not use 'the' here." O certo é "by bus".

items.q: What is the exception in the text?
items.why: "You do not say 'by foot'. You say 'on foot'."

items.q: The text says a cab is fast but expensive. It suggests that…
options: the cab is slow in the city
you may not want the cab for every trip
the cab is a cheap choice
you should always take a cab
items.why: Inferência: se é caro, não é a melhor opção para toda viagem.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: cabs are the fastest way everywhere
in central London, walking can be a good idea
you must never take the bus
the Tube is the only good option
items.why: Inferência: "Walking is often the quickest option in central London."

blocks.instruction: Ouça o colega explicar Londres ao visitante. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to London. Let me help you get around. It is easy.

First, the Tube. The Tube is the metro. It is fast and it goes everywhere. I go to the office by Tube every day. Buy an Oyster card. It makes everything easier, and it works on the bus too.

When you are on the platform, you will hear "Mind the gap". That is the Tube's famous warning. It means: watch the space between the train and the platform.

The bus is nice too. My colleague Sophie comes to work by bus. It is slow, but you see the city. And on the weekend, London transport runs 24/7, so you can go home late.

A black cab is fast, but it is expensive. I take a cab only sometimes. And remember: in the centre, walking is often the quickest option. So don't worry — you will be fine!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does the speaker go to the office every day?
items.why: "I go to the office by Tube every day."

items.q: What does the speaker say about the Oyster card?
options: You cannot use it on the bus
It only works on the Tube
items.why: "Buy an Oyster card. It makes everything easier, and it works on the bus too."

items.q: What does "Mind the gap" mean?
options: Watch the space between the train and the platform
items.why: "It means: watch the space between the train and the platform."

items.q: Why does the speaker say the bus is nice, even though it is slow?
options: Because it is the fastest option
items.why: Inferência: "It is slow, but you see the city." O lado bom é a paisagem.

items.q: What can you understand about the speaker?
options: He wants to help the visitor feel calm
He thinks the city is dangerous
items.why: Inferência: ele dá dicas simples e diz "don't worry — you will be fine!"

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I take the tube to work every morning." A tube is…
items.why: Tube = metrô (em Londres).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We wait for the bus at the ___."
items.why: Station = estação, o lugar onde você espera o transporte.

items.q: "Please show your ticket to the driver." A ticket is…
items.why: Ticket = bilhete: você precisa dele para viajar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We take the ___ to visit clients in another city."
items.why: Train = trem, bom para viagens entre cidades.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sophie comes to work by ___; it is slow but she sees the city."
items.why: Bus = ônibus, o transporte lento em que se vê a cidade.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no transporte e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Hurry up! We need to get on the bus now." To get on means to…
items.why: Get on = subir/entrar num transporte.

items.q: "This is my stop. I need to get off here." To get off means to…
items.why: Get off = descer/sair do transporte.

items.q: "I am late. I will pick you up at the station." To pick someone up means to…
options: wait for the person at home
items.why: Pick up = buscar alguém.

items.q: "Let's set off early to miss the traffic." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar a viagem.

items.q: "Sorry, I missed the train. Let's catch up tomorrow." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa/os assuntos em dia depois.
